response.sql: WITH fee_order_user AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, f.feerate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), pair_averages AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, AVG(feerate) as avg_feerate FROM fee_order_user GROUP BY orderslink, acctscope), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) as mean_feerate FROM pair_averages), filtered_pairs AS (SELECT pa.orderslink, pa.acctscope, pa.avg_feerate, pa.avg_feerate - gm.mean_feerate as excess FROM pair_averages pa CROSS JOIN global_mean gm WHERE pa.avg_feerate > gm.mean_feerate), ranked_pairs AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) as rank FROM filtered_pairs) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank FROM ranked_pairs WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank
